label: Shiny pots
on_description: potions are drawn with a stronger glint
description: Gives every potion a strong enchantment glint so pots read at a glance in the hotbar.
settings_description: Settings for the Shiny pots gameplay mod. 1.8.9 gives a potion the glint only when its effect list resolves, at vanilla strength, so on a busy hotbar a pot reads no differently from a water bottle. This draws the same glint pass vanilla uses, more times and on every potion, and can tint it with the potion's own colour. Purely the item's look: it changes nothing about which potion is which or what is in your inventory.

all_potions.description: Whether potions with no listed effect — water bottles, and server pots whose effects live only in their lore — glint too. On by default: on most servers that is exactly the pot you were trying to find.

glint_passes.description: How many times the glint is laid over a potion. 1 is vanilla's strength; 2 is the classic 1.7 look; 3 is as shiny as it gets before the item's own colour washes out.

tint_glint.description: Whether the glint takes the potion's own liquid colour instead of vanilla's purple, so a healing pot shimmers red and a speed pot blue.
